findings.title: The Node generator's --check can never pass as written
findings.detail: `scripts/build-site.mjs --check` re-renders every page and compares the result with the committed file, but the render embeds a fresh `data-generated` timestamp and relative text such as '21m ago'. Every page therefore reports stale within a minute of generation. The data itself matched when this audit compared it.
findings.action: Compare the page with the timestamp and relative-time fields normalised, or drop the strict comparison from the gate. CI does not currently run this check.

findings.title: An audit gate pins line numbers in a concurrently edited file
findings.detail: 1 evidence reference(s) cite COORDINATION.md by line number, and `audit/build_site.py --check` fails whenever that number shifts. Every session that appends to the board therefore breaks another session's build until the page is regenerated.
findings.action: Cite the section heading or a stable quote instead of a line number, or exclude the reference from the staleness comparison.
